text:
maya: Hey — trying to bring up a new HF model for quant benchmarks, `redwood-convert` keeps failing on tokenizer/special tokens. Anyone seen this pattern before?

alok: what model id + rev? any error log?

maya: model: `hf/flux-chat-3b` rev `main` (example). Command:
```
redwood-convert --model-id hf/flux-chat-3b --output /tmp/rw/flux-3b --quant 4bit --rev main
```
Error: `ValueError: missing special token mapping for <|system|>` then downstream: `KeyError: eos_token_id`

jen: hmm, sounds like tokenizer didn't include the chat-template tokens. can you paste the tokenizer config?

maya: snippet from tokenizer.json: "special_tokens_map": {"unk_token": "[UNK]", "pad_token": null} — no system/user/assistant entries. config.json has `bos_token_id: 1, eos_token_id: 2` but tokenizer vocab uses drifted ids after the safetensors import.

david: is this coming from a hub snapshot that was repacked? i've seen safetensors shard reordering break key-to-id mappings when `weight_map` renames happened during the export pipeline.

maya: also saw a warning during hub download: `WARNING: hf_hub: partial download, token expired` — one of the shards (flux-3b.safetensors-00001-of-00002) never finished. convert continued and wrote an index that references a missing shard. quantize step fails with `UnexpectedEOF` when trying to mmap the shard.

evals-bot: FYI we already saw a small chat-format regression on the nightly evals for a different model when `system` token was missing — responses started with `null:` prefixes. Might be related.

jen: quick triage steps: 1) re-download with explicit creds + `hf_hub_download(..., use_auth_token=True, allow_redirects=True)`, 2) run `transformers.TokenizerFast.from_pretrained` locally to confirm special tokens, 3) check safetensors headers: `metadata.total_shards` vs actual files.

maya: tried re-download after refreshing token — now get both shards but `redwood-convert --rev main` still renames some weight keys (there's a remapping table in the repo). convert output contains a `weight_key_renames.log` that maps `transformer.wte` -> `model.embed_tokens` which is fine, but tokenizer id offsets still off.

alok: could be a rev-pin mismatch: if the model repo has `v2` pin for tokenizer but `main` for weights, convert picks mixed revisions. try `--rev` set explicitly to the commit sha for both tokenizer + weights.

maya: good call. will try pinned sha. also seeing this in the convert logs:
```
[2026-03-12T14:02:01Z] WARN converter.safetensors: shard_count=2 declared but found=2
[2026-03-12T14:02:02Z] ERROR converter.tokenizer: special token `<|assistant|>` not present in tokenizer.json -> falling back to index -1
[2026-03-12T14:02:03Z] ERROR converter.quant: failed to quantize layer 27: mmap UnexpectedEOF
```

david: if quant step mmap fails intermittently after partial downloads, we should add a preflight that verifies each shard checksum + header before proceeding. also record which revision produced the index.

infra-bot: FYI, redwood-convert v0.9.2 has a known bug where `--rev` is applied per-file resolution but not atomically for tokenizer + weights; a fix landed in main (PR #842) to pin all artifacts to the same ref. rollout scheduled tomorrow.

jen: until patch lands, hack: `git clone` the repo at the sha, run `redwood-convert --model-dir ./local-copy --output ...` which avoids hub per-file rev resolution.

maya: cloning + local convert worked! tokenizer special tokens now present, quant completes. but chatting with the converted model shows minor prompt formatting regression: system messages appear inline instead of injected preamble.

evals-bot: please add the failing prompt set to `nightly/regressions/flux-format` so we can detect when the convert/rename pipeline changes behavior.

maya: added the evals test + opened issue linking to the safetensors partial-download + rev-pin problem. tagging @infra for the preflight checksum and @eng-ml for a post-convert smoke eval. :mag:

alok: awesome. can you attach the `weight_key_renames.log` + a small repro script? i'll help craft the preflight check.

maya: uploading logs now. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
